lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six vertical columns and four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the branchial region, transitioning from high-density small spots near the gills to larger, widely spaced blobs on the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like arrangement across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features running across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance above to shadow below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs bounded within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located along the anterior and central regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable V-shaped notch on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, indicative of physical trauma or a healed amputation.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) attached to the ventral flank posterior to the pectoral fin; pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of small-diameter spots compared to the lateral flank.
